Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single terrain plate for the Bullets of Fury 16-bit campaign map, to sit immediately NORTH of Stage 1's jungle island.
Input Image 1 is the exact map island rendering style, scale, top-down 3/4 isometric angle and pixel texture to match. Image 2 is the official Fury HQ exterior architecture reference ONLY; adapt its massive black steel launch hangar, control tower and fortified jungle compound into a small map island. Do not copy the cinematic camera or backdrop.
Generate ONE complete standalone oval/irregular island plate with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND around its whole silhouette. Entire island visible, centered with generous safe margin, no cropped island edge, no shadow rectangle or checkerboard. Dense jungle greens over rock cliffs and a tiny sandy shoreline, matching Stage 1's authored map island. On top, a compact high-tech Fury HQ: recognizable dark gunmetal launch hangar, blue-lit runway mouth pointing south toward jungle, central control tower, defensive walls and antenna, restrained blue lights. Look like a working home base, not an enemy fortress. Isometric top-down 3/4, visually consistent with the attached Stage 1 island image and the existing map. Hand-pixelled 16-bit/Neo Geo sprite treatment with sharp chunky pixel clusters and detailed lighting, no smooth photoreal rendering, no brushstroke texture. Keep silhouettes readable when displayed approximately 140x130 screen pixels. No words, no FURY HQ title, no logo plaque or UI elements; the game already overlays its own HQ plaque. No other islands, sky, ocean, enemies, ships, map grid, flags or text. The original jungle island remains a separate island farther south; this HQ island complements it without copying the runway/temple.
